WITH building_stats AS (

        b.*, 
        AVG(b."Height") OVER (PARTITION BY b."City") AS avg_city_height,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b."City" ORDER BY b."Height" DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM "buildings" b

    bstat."name" AS building_name,
    bstat."City" AS city,
    bstat.height_rank,
    o."move_in_year",
    SUM(c."Profits_billion") OVER (
        PARTITION BY c."id"
        ORDER BY o."move_in_year"
        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS running_profit
FROM building_stats bstat
JOIN "Office_locations" o
    ON bstat."id" = o."building_id"
JOIN "Companies" c
    ON o."company_id" = c."id"
WHERE bstat."Height" > bstat.avg_city_height
ORDER BY c."name", o."move_in_year";

FROM Companies c
JOIN Office_locations ol ON c.id = ol.company_id
JOIN buildings b ON ol.building_id = b.id
WHERE b.Height > (

"qualified_buildings" AS (

  FROM "buildings" b
